name: Aegean Sea (OSM coastline + EMODnet depth)
dataNote: Regional OpenStreetMap coastline covering the Aegean Sea, merged with the higher-detail Bodrum/Kos coastline. EMODnet DTM 2024 bathymetry covers the same extent at approximately 206 m resolution. Local Bodrum/Kos obstacles, restrictions, marinas and fuel docks are retained; equivalent feature coverage elsewhere in the region remains incomplete.
